findings.severityNote: Residual, no severity word; judged medium: it is a structural boundary gap (tab-chosen host-side execution on a user gesture), mitigated today only by denying the whole response surface.
findings.summary: No response-side sanitiser: anything a tab returns that carries a command, a `command:` link, trusted markdown or a remote image would put tab-chosen actions into trusted UI, run by the global ICommandService.
findings.followUp: one structural response-side control (taint by origin for commands and links; neutralise trusted markdown and remote images from tab data) before any provider, tree, SCM, status bar, decoration or notification registration is allowed; the ordinary-session classification drafts are kept unenforced in rpc-filter/policy/drafts/ (rpc session).

ref.quote: **Responses are not filtered.** The filter screens requests, never what a

findings.note: Hover and completion are the live edge of this: _executeHoverProvider and _executeCompletionItemProvider are allowed leaf exceptions, so tab-authored hover/completion content already reaches the host window, and only the registration surfaces (code lens, status bar, trees) stay denied.

findings.severityNote: Not a vulnerability: a deliberate functionality gap that is safe by default. Recorded so the loss is not mistaken for a bug or quietly reverted.
findings.summary: Methods denied pending validators and the response-side control: SCM, tree views, output channels, status bar, decorations, tab-registered language features, tasks, debug, URI handlers.
findings.rationale: Deny-by-default is the fork's chosen posture: these surfaces stay denied until a structural response-side control exists (RPC-R2), so the gap is visible loss of function rather than a containment hole. Extensions still activate, run their own commands, keep per-tab state and secrets, and read/write/search their own workspace.

ref.quote: Denied until the response-side control above lands, so these are visible

findings.note: Re-enabling any of these is a policy change that must clear check_validators and the deferred-laundering residual gate first.
